title: Add GET /api/codex/echo endpoint
description: Add a new health-style endpoint `GET /api/codex/echo` to the FastAPI backend that returns the JSON body `{"echo": true}`. The endpoint must require no query parameters, no request body, and must return HTTP 200 with Content-Type `application/json`. Register the route next to the other `/api/codex/...` routes in `backend/app/interfaces/api.py`.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/codex/echo returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type application/json
Endpoint is registered in backend/app/interfaces/api.py with the other codex routes

pinned_qa_commands.command: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -c "import urllib.request, json; r = urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:9000/api/codex/echo'); assert r.status == 200; assert r.headers['content-type'].startswith('application/json'); assert json.loads(r.read()) == {'echo': True}"

notes: Echo endpoint pattern reused for many similar health-style endpoints (ping, version). Validation is strict on the body shape.
